name: Do I need a permit for re-stucco services in Mission Viejo?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for re-stucco services in Mission Viejo?

acceptedAnswer.text: For re-stucco services in Mission Viejo, a building permit is often required, especially if the project involves significant changes to the exterior envelope or structural integrity, or if it exceeds a certain percentage of the total wall area. The exact requirements can vary, so it is crucial to check with the City of Mission Viejo's building department or consult your chosen contractor. A reputable contractor will be familiar with local regulations and can assist with obtaining the necessary permits to ensure your project complies with all local codes.
